name: Signature Shiny

components.expression: a playful, knowing smile, eyes bright with mischief.
components.effects: A playful swirl of wind catches loose leaves and her hair, {{MAGIC}} light glinting within the breeze. A fine prismatic glitter and a gilded, holographic shimmer play across the metal, the fabric and the magic, every glow edged with a rainbow sheen.
components.companion: her aligned Elder Dragon, Zephyros, flying through the clouds behind her, an Elder Dragon of windswept-jade and gossamer-silver scales, trailing wisps of racing cloud, wings like vast sails of sea-glass silk

notes: SHINY variant of the Signature: same scene and pose in a prismatic, gilded colourway with a holographic glitter sheen. Convention: <slug>-scene-signature-shiny.
